comparison.objective: Sort light cartons to a shelf and slide an identified heavy carton to a handoff mat; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Weight discrimination through test lifting, shelving, and controlled sliding versus long rigid-part orientation, compliant latching, telescoping, and fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Requires correct weight-dependent destinations, upright cartons, and no heavy drop; candidate requires complete rail attachment and structural persistence.
comparison.reason: No meaningful overlap beyond moving objects between locations.
